title: Ukwihangana kwamaze igihe kirekire mu gahinda
intro: Umusaza kwihangana kwe kwabaye inkuru nziza, iyerekwa rye ryazimye kubera agahinda, nyamara ukwizera kwe mu mugambi w'Imana ntikwigeze guhungabana. Uyu muntu yabonye abahungu cumi na babiri bakura bakaba inkingi z'imiryango, abura umwana akundwa cyane, kandi aba ikimenyetso kidashira cy'ubwihangane bwiza mu gihe cy'agahinda gakomeye. Umuntu wubahwa cyane, inkuru ye ivugwa mu mapaji yose y'ibyahishuwe. Ese ushobora kumenya uyu muntu muri Korowani?
clues: Nari umuhanuzi inkuru ye ivugwa mu buryo burambuye muri sura nkuru ya Korowani.
Nabyaye abahungu cumi na babiri babaye ba sekuruza b'imiryango ya Bani Isirayeli.
Nabwiye abahungu banjye ngo binjire mu marembo atandukanye, kugira ngo batamenyekana nk'ubwoko bumwe.
Amaso yanjye yera kubera kurira ubudahwema kubera umwana nkunda cyane namunyaze.
Nanze kwiheba nubwo abandi bahungu banjye bansabaga kubikora, bavuga ko nitotombera Allah gusa.
Ndi se w'umuhanuzi Yusufu, izina rye bwite risobanura 'umuvumbuzi' mu Cyarabu.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Kubura umuhungu wakundaga cyane kubera iriba
Kwimuka bava mu bwami busenga umuriro
trial.answer: Kubura umuhungu wakundaga cyane kubera iriba

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Yagarutse mu maso ubwo ishati y'umuhungu we yakundaga yashyirwaga ku maso
Agakiza nyuma yo gutabwa mu nda y'ifi nini
Kwakira izina rya Khalilullah riturutse kuri Allah
Kwambuka inyanja hamwe n'abantu babohowe mu bucakara
Umukororombya ugaragara nk'ikimenyetso cy'ibyiringiro nyuma y'umwuzure
outcome.answer: Yagarutse mu maso ubwo ishati y'umuhungu we yakundaga yashyirwaga ku maso

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
